periods.time: vol-11 ch-002 dusk at the start of the championship final

name.zh: 七星剑武祭决赛开幕与约定确认
name.en: Championship opening and renewal of the promise

periods.summary: Announcer Iida frames the Seven Stars festival as a stage where young knights prove dreams and dignity through battle. Stella and Ikki enter through red and blue gates, are introduced as ultimate violence and ultimate technique, then face each other on the ring. They confirm that this is the promised place they have pursued since their first duel and manifest Laevateinn and Intetsu before the final begins.
periods.cause: Ikki survives and arrives late enough for the postponed final to proceed under the eyes of more than a million spectators around the venue.
periods.outcome: The final officially begins with both finalists treating the duel as a mutual vow to surpass and stand beside each other.
periods.significance: Defines the duel's thematic stakes: Ikki and Stella are lovers, rivals, and representatives of opposing kinds of strength.
